newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT not planning share buy-backs.
newsitem.headline: NTT not planning share buy-backs.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp said on Friday that it plans to spend funds on capital investment in the multimedia business and pay back debt rather than buy back some of its own shares.

"We consider it more beneficial for shareholders to spend funds for capital investment in multimedia businesses and paying back debts... rather than buying back NTT shares," NTT senior vice president Hidekazu Inoue said at the annual shareholders' meeting.
He made the comment in response to questions from shareholders on NTT's strategy on share prices.
Asked about the possibility of implementing stock options, Inoue only said: "We are studying the system," without giving any details.
